product_idea: AI Quoting Agent for Trades — Sydney trades (roofers, painters, landscapers, electricians, plumbers) with 1-10 employees. Photo-to-quote AI, local rate-card learning, SMS/email quote delivery with read receipts. $99/month per crew with 14-day trial. Target Parramatta, Blacktown, Penrith suburbs. Builds on existing DA aggregator wedge.
wedge_sentence: For 1–10 staff Western Sydney trade owners, a site photo becomes an SMS-sent, AU-priced, NSW-licence-bound quote in under 5 minutes.
icp: 1–10 staff Western Sydney roofer/painter (then sparkie/plumber/landscaper) owner-operator, A$300K–A$2M revenue, holding NSW contractor licence, already paying for ServiceM8/Tradify
anti_axis: Not an FSM; no scheduling/invoicing/payments/dispatch; not commercial; not crews >10; not non-NSW V1; not desktop-first; not US-priced
